use_case: AI estimating and bid assistant: quantity takeoff from drawings, unit pricing from the company's historical cost database, subcontractor bid leveling and recommendations, and proposal drafting
vendor_or_model: AI estimating SaaS vendor (computer vision takeoff plus a generative language model with retrieval over the estimating database); enterprise terms since 2026-02
data_categories: Drawings and specifications (FCI on awarded federal contracts; owners' confidential drawings; CUI prohibited and blocked); historical costs and bid pricing; subcontractor bids and contact details
consequential_decision_category: None directly (business decisions on bids and subcontractors); re-tier to Employment if used for hiring or crew assignment, or to Safety/CI if used for structural or life-safety quantities
human_in_the_loop: Estimator verifies every takeoff for major trades and records the reason for each subcontractor selection; Director of Preconstruction approves every bid and signs any federal price certification
applicable_laws: N23-R01 FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) for FCI; DFARS 252.204-7012 and POL-04 4.10 (no CUI); DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) once a contract requires CMMC; FAR 52.203-2 independent price determination; FAR 15.403-4 certified cost or pricing data when required; FAR 52.219-8 and 52.219-9 small business participation; Sherman Act Sec. 1 (counsel); FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: Approved with conditions (in production for 18 estimators since 2026-02)

use_case: Jobsite safety video analytics: detects missing hard hats and vests and people inside equipment exclusion zones on rented jobsite cameras, and sends alerts to the site safety manager
vendor_or_model: Jobsite camera rental vendor's analytics feature (computer vision); cameras and analytics vendor-operated (SYS-11)
data_categories: Video of workers, subcontractor crews, and visitors at 14 jobsites (no audio); alert snapshots
consequential_decision_category: None today (safety coaching); Employment if alerts are used for discipline, which is prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Site safety manager reviews every alert before any conversation with a worker; alerts are never used for discipline or pay decisions
applicable_laws: Worker notice (company rule; POL-05); Fla. Stat. 934.03 all-party consent only if audio is ever enabled (disabled); National Labor Relations Act (counsel review of monitoring); N23-R02 FAR 52.204-25 for camera hardware on federal jobs; owner and installation restrictions on imaging federal facilities
status: Approved with conditions (in production since 2025; worker notice and 30-day retention by 2026-10-31)

use_case: Productivity suite generative AI assistant: drafts and summarizes email, documents, meeting notes, and chat using the user's own access to company files
business_owner: Director of VDC (sponsor of the 2026 rollout), with the IT Director as technical owner
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor's generative AI assistant (large language model inside the suite tenant; no training on tenant data under the suite terms)
data_categories: Everything the user can open in SYS-05: email, files, chat; FCI; bid and pricing data; employee information. Cannot reach the CPE
human_in_the_loop: Users review all drafts before sending; the assistant cannot send email or change permissions on its own
applicable_laws: N23-R01 FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(ii) (limit access to authorized transactions and functions); POL-04 4.10 (no CUI); owner contract confidentiality clauses
status: Restricted: limited to 120 reviewed users until the oversharing clean-up is complete (due 2026-11-30)

use_case: Accounts payable invoice capture and coding: reads subcontractor and supplier invoices and lien waivers, extracts amounts and remittance details, and proposes job-cost coding
vendor_or_model: Accounts payable automation vendor (optical character recognition with machine learning coding and a language model for field extraction), integrated with SYS-02
data_categories: Invoices, lien waivers, pay app backup, remittance and bank details of about 450 subcontractors and suppliers
human_in_the_loop: Accounts payable staff approve every coded invoice; the tool cannot write to vendor-master bank fields; any remittance that differs from the vendor master goes to the Controller's call-back queue
applicable_laws: POL-01 4.8 and STD-04 (bank change verification); FAR 52.232-27(c) (payment timing on federal jobs); FAR 52.232-33 (federal EFT)
status: Approved with conditions (in production since 2025-09; bank-field write access removed 2026-09-15)

use_case: MBSS alarm triage: classifies alarms and events from client access control, video, and building automation systems, groups duplicates, and suppresses events it scores as nuisance
business_owner: Director of Technology and Security Systems
vendor_or_model: RMM software vendor's machine learning alarm classification module (VEN-08)
data_categories: Alarm and event streams from 38 client sites; door, camera, and controller status; alarm response notes
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (client building occupants: hospitals, schools, county buildings)
human_in_the_loop: Critical alarm classes (door forced, door held at secured areas, controller offline, camera tamper, BAS life-safety interfaces) are never suppressed; technicians review the suppressed queue each shift; weekly review of suppression rules by the Director of Technology and Security Systems
applicable_laws: MBSS agreements (1-hour response to critical alerts); SOC 2 commitments (P09 CC3.4, CC7.2); no sector-specific AI law identified
status: Approved with conditions (in production since 2025-11; critical-class suppression disabled 2026-09-11)

use_case: Applicant screening: the applicant tracking feature ranks applicants for craft, field, and office roles against job requirements and suggests who to interview
vendor_or_model: Payroll, HR, and applicant tracking vendor's ranking feature (machine learning model; VEN-06)
data_categories: Applications, resumes, screening question answers, work history; about 2,400 applicants a year
human_in_the_loop: Today: ranking turned off 2026-08-28; recruiters review every applicant. If re-enabled: ranking advisory only, recruiters review all qualified applicants, and every rejection has a recorded reason
applicable_laws: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures (29 CFR 1607, four-fifths rule in 1607.4(D)); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 621 et seq.); ADA (42 U.S.C. 12112); state AI employment laws where roles are posted outside Florida (counsel)
status: Suspended: ranking off until an adverse impact analysis and vendor validation evidence are reviewed (due 2026-10-31)
